lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular local maxima organized into four to five distinct vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with the largest clusters situated along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges extending along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge to deep shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-luminance blobs concentrated near the anterior base and lower half of the first dorsal fin silhouette; the distal portion of the fin is largely uniform and dark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregular indentation on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; multiple smaller organisms (remoras) are visible as attached high-contrast silhouettes on the ventral surface and near the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense field of micro-scale high-luminance dots across the cephalic region, exhibiting a significantly higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter compared to the macropatterning on the posterior flank.
